command: set -e; export PYTEST_PLUGINS= PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 MYPYC_STRICT_DUNDER_TYPING=1; python -m pip install --no-deps coverage==7.10.7; python -m pip install --no-build-isolation -r requirements-build.txt; python -c "from scripts.run_mypyc_build import build_mypyc_command, run_checked; run_checked(build_mypyc_command())"; cd tests/unit; set +e; python -m coverage run --branch --source=dank_mids -m pytest; status=$?; python -m coverage json -o /reports/unit-coverage.json; exit "$status"

cgroup_before.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0

cgroup_after.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0
